title: A simple understanding of quantum electrodynamics using Bohmian trajectories: detecting non-ontic photons
summary: The use of Bohmian mechanics as a practical tool for modeling non-relativistic quantum phenomena of matter provides clear evidence of its success, not only as a way to interpret the foundations of quantum mechanics, but also as a computational framework. In the literature, it is frequently argued that such a realistic view-based on deterministic trajectories cannot account for phenomena involving the "creation" and "annihilation" of photons.
